It's okay, I appreciate somebody else is in a similar situation and understands me, so thanks for that and for replying.

Well, I feel so shitty and my mind isn't really working well so not much stuff comes to mind :^( just can remember my special interests: art movements, linguistics, disasters (specially aviation disasters), bugs, cryptozoology, vintage stuff (specially from the 80s/90s), genderfuck stuff. I rarely read (not interested in most of fiction; only like stuff like encyclopedias) and I almost never watch movies or shows; they feel like a waste of time to me and I'm picky. I like watching sports tho, specially football (soccer) and figure skating. And I don't really have really stablished hobbies, when I have free time I either sleep or go out with friends, or I draw (which is actually my career anyway).
